name: sim.observe
description: Observe the owned robot pose, nearby objects, contacts, ASCII map and deliveryAreas with crate-center bounds. A crate counts only when released (not held) and fully inside its assigned zone: abs(x - zone.x) <= width/2 - 0.3 and abs(y - zone.y) <= depth/2 - 0.3. The crate is 0.6 m wide/deep. Aim for the zone center, release, advance or submit, then verify delivered. There is no additional speed or settling-time test; bounds are conservative on a 1e-6 grid; aim at the center for motion tolerance.

name: robot.drive
description: Set differential drive velocity for a bounded number of simulation seconds.

name: robot.goto
description: Follow an obstacle-aware path to an arena coordinate at up to 1.5 m/s.

name: robot.grab
description: Attach an assigned crate within 0.85 m of the robot front.

name: robot.release
description: Release the held crate. A crate counts only when released (not held) and fully inside its assigned zone: abs(x - zone.x) <= width/2 - 0.3 and abs(y - zone.y) <= depth/2 - 0.3. The crate is 0.6 m wide/deep. Aim for the zone center, release, advance or submit, then verify delivered. There is no additional speed or settling-time test; bounds are conservative on a 1e-6 grid; aim at the center for motion tolerance.

Aim for the zone center, release, advance or submit, then verify delivered.
